title: Auto Entity Profile Generation
date: 2026-03-11
tags:
  - idea
source: ad-hoc
---

Idea: automatically generate profiles for people, companies, and concepts that appear frequently across vault notes.

When an entity (author, speaker, company, framework) gets tagged or mentioned across 3+ notes, auto-generate a profile note in notes/references/ with:
- Bio / overview
- All vault notes mentioning them (backlinks)
- Their key ideas or contributions (from vault context)
- Related entities (who they're connected to in the vault)
- External links (homepage, Twitter, Wikipedia)

This turns recurring names into first-class nodes in the knowledge graph rather than just inline mentions. Could aggregate stats like: first mentioned, mention count, topic clusters they appear in.

Examples from current vault: Sam Kriss (writer), Tim Berglund (context engineering), a16z (firm), HumanLayer (company), Klarna (case study).
